windowTitles: Part of the window title, case-insensitive
styleHint: One or two sentences on how the writing should sound. This goes straight into the system prompt, so be concrete: 'terse military radio chatter', 'wry and modern, lots of sarcasm', 'formal medieval court speech'. Leaving it out gives you flat, neutral prose regardless of the game.
notes: Copy this folder, rename it to your game's id, and fill in the three files. Nothing here needs a code change - the app discovers profiles by scanning this directory.
